description.value: The Pomeroy Sport Centre is a large municipal recreation facility in Fort St. John operated by the City. It features ice hockey, speed skating, and a walking track across a four-storey building. Fort St. John sits on the Alaska Highway, making it a common stopover for touring cyclists heading north.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is almost entirely navigation menus from the City of Fort St. John site, with virtually no descriptive content about the Pomeroy Sport Centre itself. OSM tags confirm it is a municipal sports centre (ice hockey, speed skating, walking track) at 9324 96 Street. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, showers, or any other amenities could be extracted from the website text. The facility appears operational as it is listed under current Parks and Recreation facilities on the city website.
concerns: Website page loaded but contained only navigation menus with no descriptive content about the facility, so almost no amenities could be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The facility is a legitimate municipal sports centre on a major cycling corridor, but the website yielded no usable detail about amenities. None of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed. Manual verification is needed to determine if the facility offers cyclist-friendly services.

wow_evidence: Four-storey facility with one of Canada's few indoor long-track speed-skating ovals (own knowledge) plus walking track; no pool.
blurb: Fort St. John's sport centre with an indoor long-track speed-skating oval.
